The amortized cost of the charge after applying all reduced rates, discounts, and the applicable portion of relevant, prepaid purchases (one-time or recurring) that covered this charge. ### Concerning Granularity and Distribution of Recurring Fee Providers should distribute the commitment purchase amount instead of including a row at the beginning of a period so practitioners do not need to manually distribute the fee themselves. ### Concerning Amortization Approaches Eligible purchases should be amortized using a methodology determined by the provider that reflects the needs of their customer base and is proportional to the Pricing Quantity and the time granularity of the row. Should a practitioner desire to amortize relevant purchases using a different approach, the practitioner can do so using the Billed Cost for the line item representing the initial purchase.
